title: Optus confirms fourth death after CEO reveals warnings of failed triple zero calls not escalated
summary: Emergency calls were offline for nearly 14 hours, during which four people died – including an eight-week-old baby Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A fourth person died during Optus’s network outage on Thursday, its CEO has confirmed. Stephen Rue said in a statement released on Saturday afternoon that the telco was “saddened to learn of a new fatality in Western Australia, which appears to have occurred during the outage period”.
